about: Screw secondary-op machine, self-made in Blender (sources/screw/build_screw.py) from makers' photos of bowl-fed slotting machines (Alight indexing slotting machines and similar, found by image search) and the record: the taupe cabinet on its plinth with louvred doors and a nameplate; the stainless table with its chip lip; the vibratory bowl feeder on its drive (stainless bowl, green-lined cone, the spiral track climbing its wall with parts on it, the orange overflow catch); the inclined rails down to the slotting head (escapement and its cylinder, the slitting saw under its yellow guard, the arbor, the blue drive motor on top); a coolant nozzle; the console with lit counters and buttons; the signal light; the finished-parts chute and tray. Where the placeholder (planner.placeholders.screw_slotter) has its boxes.
reviewed: 2026-11-06: modelled against maker photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked

source.made: self-made in Blender from public dimensions and photos; build script and .blend beside it

screw_taupe.about: the cabinet's, feeder drive's and console's warm grey (taupe) enamel

screw_dark.about: the slotting head's dark castings, the plinth, track supports and feet

screw_green.about: the bowl feeder's green polyurethane lining

screw_orange.about: the bowl's overflow catch and the coolant nozzles

screw_red.about: stop buttons and the signal light's red

screw_white.about: the finished-parts tray and the nameplate

double_sided_why: self-made closed solids, normals checked outward when built (jig.orient), hidden faces culled: single-sided saves fill rate
sources_used: the record (vibratory bowl feed, slitting-saw slotting or cross drilling, 20-60 parts/min) and its placeholder's boxes
maker photos of bowl-fed screw-head slotting machines (alight.co.in 'Indexing Slotting Machine' and similar) found by image search

unsure.what: generic: no maker; colours follow the common taupe-cabinet, stainless-bowl, yellow-guard look, the motor blue as the placeholder had it
